ayahs.arabicText: كٓهٰیٰعٓصٓ۫ۚ
ayahs.translation: Kaf. Ha'. Ya'. Ayn. Sad.

ayahs.arabicText: ذِكْرُ رَحْمَتِ رَبِّكَ عَبْدَهٗ زَكَرِیَّاۖۚ
ayahs.translation: This is an account of the mercy of your Lord to His servant Zechariah

ayahs.arabicText: اِذْ نَادٰى رَبَّهٗ نِدَآءً خَفِیًّا
ayahs.translation: when he cried to his Lord in secret.

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ رَبِّ اِنِّیْ وَهَنَ الْعَظْمُ مِنِّیْ وَ اشْتَعَلَ الرَّاْسُ شَیْبًا وَّ لَمْ اَكُنْۢ بِدُعَآئِكَ رَبِّ شَقِیًّا
ayahs.translation: He said: "Lord! My bones have grown feeble and my head is glistening with age; yet, never have my prayers to You, my Lord, been unfruitful.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اِنِّیْ خِفْتُ الْمَوَالِیَ مِنْ وَّرَآءِیْ وَ كَانَتِ امْرَاَتِیْ عَاقِرًا فَهَبْ لِیْ مِنْ لَّدُنْكَ وَلِیًّاۙ
ayahs.translation: I fear evil from my kinsmen after I am gone; and my wife is barren, so grant me an heir out of Your special grace,

ayahs.arabicText: یَّرِثُنِیْ وَ یَرِثُ مِنْ اٰلِ یَعْقُوْبَ١ۖۗ وَ اجْعَلْهُ رَبِّ رَضِیًّا
ayahs.translation: one that might be my heir and the heir of the house of Jacob; and make him, Lord, one that will be pleasing to You.

ayahs.arabicText: یٰزَكَرِیَّاۤ اِنَّا نُبَشِّرُكَ بِغُلٰمِ اِ۟سْمُهٗ یَحْیٰى١ۙ لَمْ نَجْعَلْ لَّهٗ مِنْ قَبْلُ سَمِیًّا
ayahs.translation: (He was told): "Zechariah, We bring you the good news of the birth of a son whose name shall be Yahya (John), one whose namesake We never created before."

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ رَبِّ اَنّٰى یَكُوْنُ لِیْ غُلٰمٌ وَّ كَانَتِ امْرَاَتِیْ عَاقِرًا وَّ قَدْ بَلَغْتُ مِنَ الْكِبَرِ عِتِیًّا
ayahs.translation: He said: "My Lord! How can I have a boy when my wife is barren and I have reached an extremely old age?"

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ كَذٰلِكَ١ۚ قَالَ رَبُّكَ هُوَ عَلَیَّ هَیِّنٌ وَّ قَدْ خَلَقْتُكَ مِنْ قَبْلُ وَ لَمْ تَكُ شَیْئًا
ayahs.translation: He answered: "So shall it be." Your Lord says: "It is easy for Me," and then added: "For beyond doubt, I created you earlier when you were nothing."

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ رَبِّ اجْعَلْ لِّیْۤ اٰیَةً١ؕ قَالَ اٰیَتُكَ اَلَّا تُكَلِّمَ النَّاسَ ثَلٰثَ لَیَالٍ سَوِیًّا
ayahs.translation: Zechariah said: "Lord, grant me a Sign." Said He: "Your Sign is that you shall not be able to speak to people for three nights, though you will be otherwise sound."

ayahs.arabicText: فَخَرَجَ عَلٰى قَوْمِهٖ مِنَ الْمِحْرَابِ فَاَوْحٰۤى اِلَیْهِمْ اَنْ سَبِّحُوْا بُكْرَةً وَّ عَشِیًّا
ayahs.translation: Thereupon Zechariah came out from the sanctuary and directed his people by gestures to extol His glory by day and by night.

ayahs.arabicText: یٰیَحْیٰى خُذِ الْكِتٰبَ بِقُوَّةٍ١ؕ وَ اٰتَیْنٰهُ الْحُكْمَ صَبِیًّاۙ
ayahs.translation: "O John! Hold the Book with all your strength." We had bestowed wisdom upon him while he was still a child;

ayahs.arabicText: وَّ حَنَانًا مِّنْ لَّدُنَّا وَ زَكٰوةً١ؕ وَ كَانَ تَقِیًّاۙ
ayahs.translation: and We also endowed him with tenderness and purity, and he was exceedingly pious

ayahs.arabicText: وَّ بَرًّۢا بِوَالِدَیْهِ وَ لَمْ یَكُنْ جَبَّارًا عَصِیًّا
ayahs.translation: and cherishing to his parents. Never was he insolent or rebellious.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ سَلٰمٌ عَلَیْهِ یَوْمَ وُلِدَ وَ یَوْمَ یَمُوْتُ وَ یَوْمَ یُبْعَثُ حَیًّا۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: Peace be upon him the day he was born, and the day he will die, and the day he will be raised up alive.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اذْكُرْ فِی الْكِتٰبِ مَرْیَمَ١ۘ اِذِ انْتَبَذَتْ مِنْ اَهْلِهَا مَكَانًا شَرْقِیًّاۙ
ayahs.translation: (O Muhammad), recite in the Book the account of Mary, when she withdrew from her people to a place towards the east;

ayahs.arabicText: فَاتَّخَذَتْ مِنْ دُوْنِهِمْ حِجَابًا١۪۫ فَاَرْسَلْنَاۤ اِلَیْهَا رُوْحَنَا فَتَمَثَّلَ لَهَا بَشَرًا سَوِیًّا
ayahs.translation: and drew a curtain, screening herself from people whereupon We sent to her Our spirit and he appeared to her as a well-shaped man.

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَتْ اِنِّیْۤ اَعُوْذُ بِالرَّحْمٰنِ مِنْكَ اِنْ كُنْتَ تَقِیًّا
ayahs.translation: Mary exclaimed: "I surely take refuge from you with the Most Compassionate Lord, if you are at all God-fearing."

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ اِنَّمَاۤ اَنَا رَسُوْلُ رَبِّكِ١ۖۗ لِاَهَبَ لَكِ غُلٰمًا زَكِیًّا
ayahs.translation: He said: "I am just a message-bearer of your Lord, I have come to grant you a most pure boy."

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَتْ اَنّٰى یَكُوْنُ لِیْ غُلٰمٌ وَّ لَمْ یَمْسَسْنِیْ بَشَرٌ وَّ لَمْ اَكُ بَغِیًّا
ayahs.translation: Mary said: "How can a boy be born to me when no man has even touched me, nor have I ever been unchaste?"

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ كَذٰلِكِ١ۚ قَالَ رَبُّكِ هُوَ عَلَیَّ هَیِّنٌ١ۚ وَ لِنَجْعَلَهٗۤ اٰیَةً لِّلنَّاسِ وَ رَحْمَةً مِّنَّا١ۚ وَ كَانَ اَمْرًا مَّقْضِیًّا
ayahs.translation: The angel said: "Thus shall it be. Your Lord says: 'It is easy for Me; and We shall do so in order to make him a Sign for mankind and a mercy from Us. This has been decreed.' "

ayahs.arabicText: فَحَمَلَتْهُ فَانْتَبَذَتْ بِهٖ مَكَانًا قَصِیًّا
ayahs.translation: Then she conceived him and withdrew with him to a far-off place.

ayahs.arabicText: فَاَجَآءَهَا الْمَخَاضُ اِلٰى جِذْعِ النَّخْلَةِ١ۚ قَالَتْ یٰلَیْتَنِیْ مِتُّ قَبْلَ هٰذَا وَ كُنْتُ نَسْیًا مَّنْسِیًّا
ayahs.translation: Then the birth pangs drove her to the trunk of a palm-tree and she said: "Oh, would that I had died before this and had been all forgotten."

ayahs.arabicText: فَنَادٰىهَا مِنْ تَحْتِهَاۤ اَلَّا تَحْزَنِیْ قَدْ جَعَلَ رَبُّكِ تَحْتَكِ سَرِیًّا
ayahs.translation: Thereupon the angel below her cried out: "Grieve not, for your Lord has caused a stream of water to flow beneath you.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ هُزِّیْۤ اِلَیْكِ بِجِذْعِ النَّخْلَةِ تُسٰقِطْ عَلَیْكِ رُطَبًا جَنِیًّا٘
ayahs.translation: Shake the trunk of the palm-tree towards yourself and fresh and ripe dates shall fall upon you.

ayahs.arabicText: فَكُلِیْ وَ اشْرَبِیْ وَ قَرِّیْ عَیْنًا١ۚ فَاِمَّا تَرَیِنَّ مِنَ الْبَشَرِ اَحَدًا١ۙ فَقُوْلِیْۤ اِنِّیْ نَذَرْتُ لِلرَّحْمٰنِ صَوْمًا فَلَنْ اُكَلِّمَ الْیَوْمَ اِنْسِیًّاۚ
ayahs.translation: So eat and drink and cool your eyes; and if you see any person say to him: 'Verily I have vowed a fast to the Most Compassionate Lord, and so I shall not speak to anyone today.' "

ayahs.arabicText: فَاَتَتْ بِهٖ قَوْمَهَا تَحْمِلُهٗ١ؕ قَالُوْا یٰمَرْیَمُ لَقَدْ جِئْتِ شَیْئًا فَرِیًّا
ayahs.translation: Then she came to her people, carrying her baby. They said: "O Mary! You have committed a monstrous thing.

ayahs.arabicText: یٰۤاُخْتَ هٰرُوْنَ مَا كَانَ اَبُوْكِ امْرَاَ سَوْءٍ وَّ مَا كَانَتْ اُمُّكِ بَغِیًّاۖۚ
ayahs.translation: O sister of Aaron! Your father was not an evil man, nor was your mother an unchaste woman."

ayahs.arabicText: فَاَشَارَتْ اِلَیْهِ١ؕ قَالُوْا كَیْفَ نُكَلِّمُ مَنْ كَانَ فِی الْمَهْدِ صَبِیًّا
ayahs.translation: Thereupon Mary pointed to the child. They exclaimed: "How can we speak to one who is in the cradle, a mere child?"

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ اِنِّیْ عَبْدُ اللّٰهِ١ؕ۫ اٰتٰىنِیَ الْكِتٰبَ وَ جَعَلَنِیْ نَبِیًّاۙ
ayahs.translation: The child cried out: "Verily I am Allah's servant. He has granted me the Book and has made me a Prophet

ayahs.arabicText: وَّ جَعَلَنِیْ مُبٰرَكًا اَیْنَ مَا كُنْتُ١۪ وَ اَوْصٰنِیْ بِالصَّلٰوةِ وَ الزَّكٰوةِ مَا دُمْتُ حَیًّا٢۪ۖ
ayahs.translation: and has blessed me wherever I might be and has enjoined upon me Prayer and Zakah (purifying alms) as long as I live;

ayahs.arabicText: وَّ بَرًّۢا بِوَالِدَتِیْ١٘ وَ لَمْ یَجْعَلْنِیْ جَبَّارًا شَقِیًّا
ayahs.translation: and has made me dutiful to my mother. He has not made me oppressive, nor bereft of God's blessings.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ السَّلٰمُ عَلَیَّ یَوْمَ وُلِدْتُّ وَ یَوْمَ اَمُوْتُ وَ یَوْمَ اُبْعَثُ حَیًّا
ayahs.translation: Peace be upon me the day I was born and the day I will die, and the day I will be raised up alive."

ayahs.arabicText: ذٰلِكَ عِیْسَى ابْنُ مَرْیَمَ١ۚ قَوْلَ الْحَقِّ الَّذِیْ فِیْهِ یَمْتَرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: This is Jesus, the son of Mary; and this is the truth about him concerning which they are in doubt.

ayahs.arabicText: مَا كَانَ لِلّٰهِ اَنْ یَّتَّخِذَ مِنْ وَّلَدٍ١ۙ سُبْحٰنَهٗ١ؕ اِذَا قَضٰۤى اَمْرًا فَاِنَّمَا یَقُوْلُ لَهٗ كُنْ فَیَكُوْنُؕ
ayahs.translation: It does not befit Allah to take for Himself a son. Glory be to Him! When He decrees a thing He only says: "Be" and it is.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ رَبِّیْ وَ رَبُّكُمْ فَاعْبُدُوْهُ١ؕ هٰذَا صِرَاطٌ مُّسْتَقِیْمٌ
ayahs.translation: (Jesus had said): "Indeed Allah is my Lord and your Lord, so serve Him alone. This is the Straight Way."

ayahs.arabicText: فَاخْتَلَفَ الْاَحْزَابُ مِنْۢ بَیْنِهِمْ١ۚ فَوَیْلٌ لِّلَّذِیْنَ كَفَرُوْا مِنْ مَّشْهَدِ یَوْمٍ عَظِیْمٍ
ayahs.translation: But different parties began to dispute with one another. A dreadful woe awaits on that great Day for those that reject the Truth.

ayahs.arabicText: اَسْمِعْ بِهِمْ وَ اَبْصِرْ١ۙ یَوْمَ یَاْتُوْنَنَا لٰكِنِ الظّٰلِمُوْنَ الْیَوْمَ فِیْ ضَلٰلٍ مُّبِیْنٍ
ayahs.translation: How well shall they hear and how well shall they see on the Day they come to Us! But today the evil-doers are in manifest error.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اَنْذِرْهُمْ یَوْمَ الْحَسْرَةِ اِذْ قُضِیَ الْاَمْرُ١ۘ وَ هُمْ فِیْ غَفْلَةٍ وَّ هُمْ لَا یُؤْمِنُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: (O Muhammad), warn those who are steeped in heedlessness and are obstinately rejecting the truth that the Day shall come when things will be finally decided and they shall be left with utter remorse.

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّا نَحْنُ نَرِثُ الْاَرْضَ وَ مَنْ عَلَیْهَا وَ اِلَیْنَا یُرْجَعُوْنَ۠
ayahs.translation: Ultimately, We shall inherit the earth and whatever is on it; to Us shall they be returned.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اذْكُرْ فِی الْكِتٰبِ اِبْرٰهِیْمَ١ؕ۬ اِنَّهٗ كَانَ صِدِّیْقًا نَّبِیًّا ۧ
ayahs.translation: (O Muhammad), recite in the Book the account of Abraham. Most surely he was a man of truth, a Prophet.

ayahs.arabicText: اِذْ قَالَ لِاَبِیْهِ یٰۤاَبَتِ لِمَ تَعْبُدُ مَا لَا یَسْمَعُ وَ لَا یُبْصِرُ وَ لَا یُغْنِیْ عَنْكَ شَیْئًا
ayahs.translation: (And remind people) when he said to his father: "Father! Why do you worship that which neither sees nor hears, and which can be of no avail to you?

ayahs.arabicText: یٰۤاَبَتِ اِنِّیْ قَدْ جَآءَنِیْ مِنَ الْعِلْمِ مَا لَمْ یَاْتِكَ فَاتَّبِعْنِیْۤ اَهْدِكَ صِرَاطًا سَوِیًّا
ayahs.translation: Father, a knowledge that has not reached you has come to me. So follow me that I may guide you to a Straight Way.

ayahs.arabicText: یٰۤاَبَتِ لَا تَعْبُدِ الشَّیْطٰنَ١ؕ اِنَّ الشَّیْطٰنَ كَانَ لِلرَّحْمٰنِ عَصِیًّا
ayahs.translation: Father, do not serve Satan, for Satan has indeed been a persistent rebel against the Most Compassionate Lord.

ayahs.arabicText: یٰۤاَبَتِ اِنِّیْۤ اَخَافُ اَنْ یَّمَسَّكَ عَذَابٌ مِّنَ الرَّحْمٰنِ فَتَكُوْنَ لِلشَّیْطٰنِ وَلِیًّا
ayahs.translation: Father, I fear that a punishment from the Most Compassionate Lord might strike you and you may end up as one of Satan's companions?"

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ اَرَاغِبٌ اَنْتَ عَنْ اٰلِهَتِیْ یٰۤاِبْرٰهِیْمُ١ۚ لَئِنْ لَّمْ تَنْتَهِ لَاَرْجُمَنَّكَ وَ اهْجُرْنِیْ مَلِیًّا
ayahs.translation: The father said: "Abraham, have you turned away from my gods? If you do not give this up, I shall stone you to death. Now begone from me forever."

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ سَلٰمٌ عَلَیْكَ١ۚ سَاَسْتَغْفِرُ لَكَ رَبِّیْ١ؕ اِنَّهٗ كَانَ بِیْ حَفِیًّا
ayahs.translation: Abraham answered: "Peace be upon you. I shall seek pardon for you from my Lord. My Lord has always been kind to Me.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اَعْتَزِلُكُمْ وَ مَا تَدْعُوْنَ مِنْ دُوْنِ اللّٰهِ وَ اَدْعُوْا رَبِّیْ١ۖ٘ عَسٰۤى اَلَّاۤ اَكُوْنَ بِدُعَآءِ رَبِّیْ شَقِیًّا
ayahs.translation: I shall withdraw from you and all that you call upon beside Allah. I shall only call upon my Lord. I trust the prayer to my Lord will not go unanswered."

ayahs.arabicText: فَلَمَّا اعْتَزَلَهُمْ وَ مَا یَعْبُدُوْنَ مِنْ دُوْنِ اللّٰهِ١ۙ وَهَبْنَا لَهٗۤ اِسْحٰقَ وَ یَعْقُوْبَ١ؕ وَ كُلًّا جَعَلْنَا نَبِیًّا
ayahs.translation: Thereupon Abraham dissociated himself from his people and the deities they worshipped instead of Allah, and We bestowed upon him Isaac and Jacob and made each of them a Prophet;

ayahs.arabicText: وَ وَهَبْنَا لَهُمْ مِّنْ رَّحْمَتِنَا وَ جَعَلْنَا لَهُمْ لِسَانَ صِدْقٍ عَلِیًّا۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: and We bestowed on them Our mercy, and granted them a truly lofty renown.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اذْكُرْ فِی الْكِتٰبِ مُوْسٰۤى١٘ اِنَّهٗ كَانَ مُخْلَصًا وَّ كَانَ رَسُوْلًا نَّبِیًّا
ayahs.translation: And recite in the Book the account of Moses. He was a chosen one, a Messenger, a Prophet.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ نَادَیْنٰهُ مِنْ جَانِبِ الطُّوْرِ الْاَیْمَنِ وَ قَرَّبْنٰهُ نَجِیًّا
ayahs.translation: We called out to him from the right side of the Mount, and We drew him near to Us by communing to him in secret,

ayahs.arabicText: وَ وَهَبْنَا لَهٗ مِنْ رَّحْمَتِنَاۤ اَخَاهُ هٰرُوْنَ نَبِیًّا
ayahs.translation: and out of Our mercy We appointed his brother Aaron, a Prophet (that he may assist him).

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اذْكُرْ فِی الْكِتٰبِ اِسْمٰعِیْلَ١٘ اِنَّهٗ كَانَ صَادِقَ الْوَعْدِ وَ كَانَ رَسُوْلًا نَّبِیًّاۚ
ayahs.translation: And recite in the Book the account of Ishmael. He was ever true to his promise, and was a Messenger, a Prophet.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ كَانَ یَاْمُرُ اَهْلَهٗ بِالصَّلٰوةِ وَ الزَّكٰوةِ١۪ وَ كَانَ عِنْدَ رَبِّهٖ مَرْضِیًّا
ayahs.translation: He enjoined his household to observe Prayer and to give Zakah (purifying alms); and his Lord was well pleased with him.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اذْكُرْ فِی الْكِتٰبِ اِدْرِیْسَ١٘ اِنَّهٗ كَانَ صِدِّیْقًا نَّبِیًّاۗۙ
ayahs.translation: And recite in the Book the account of Idris. He was a man of truth, a Prophet;

ayahs.arabicText: وَّ رَفَعْنٰهُ مَكَانًا عَلِیًّا
ayahs.translation: and We exalted him to a lofty position.

ayahs.arabicText: اُولٰٓئِكَ الَّذِیْنَ اَنْعَمَ اللّٰهُ عَلَیْهِمْ مِّنَ النَّبِیّٖنَ مِنْ ذُرِّیَّةِ اٰدَمَ١ۗ وَ مِمَّنْ حَمَلْنَا مَعَ نُوْحٍ١٘ وَّ مِنْ ذُرِّیَّةِ اِبْرٰهِیْمَ وَ اِسْرَآءِیْلَ١٘ وَ مِمَّنْ هَدَیْنَا وَ اجْتَبَیْنَا١ؕ اِذَا تُتْلٰى عَلَیْهِمْ اٰیٰتُ الرَّحْمٰنِ خَرُّوْا سُجَّدًا وَّ بُكِیًّا۩ ۞
ayahs.translation: These are the Prophets upon whom Allah bestowed His favour from the seed of Adam, and from the seed of those whom We carried (in the Ark) with Noah, and from the seed of Abraham and Israel. They were those whom We guided and chose (for an exalted position). They were such that when the words of the Most Compassionate Lord were recited to them, they fell down in prostration, weeping.

ayahs.arabicText: فَخَلَفَ مِنْۢ بَعْدِهِمْ خَلْفٌ اَضَاعُوا الصَّلٰوةَ وَ اتَّبَعُوا الشَّهَوٰتِ فَسَوْفَ یَلْقَوْنَ غَیًّاۙ
ayahs.translation: They were succeeded by a people who neglected the Prayers and pursued their lusts. They shall presently meet with their doom,

ayahs.arabicText: اِلَّا مَنْ تَابَ وَ اٰمَنَ وَ عَمِلَ صَالِحًا فَاُولٰٓئِكَ یَدْخُلُوْنَ الْجَنَّةَ وَ لَا یُظْلَمُوْنَ شَیْئًاۙ
ayahs.translation: except those who repent and believe and act righteously. Such shall enter Paradise and shall not be wronged at all.

ayahs.arabicText: جَنّٰتِ عَدْنِ اِ۟لَّتِیْ وَعَدَ الرَّحْمٰنُ عِبَادَهٗ بِالْغَیْبِ١ؕ اِنَّهٗ كَانَ وَعْدُهٗ مَاْتِیًّا
ayahs.translation: Theirs shall be everlasting Gardens which the Most Compassionate Lord has promised His servants in a realm which is beyond the ken of perception. Surely His promise shall he fulfilled.

ayahs.arabicText: لَا یَسْمَعُوْنَ فِیْهَا لَغْوًا اِلَّا سَلٰمًا١ؕ وَ لَهُمْ رِزْقُهُمْ فِیْهَا بُكْرَةً وَّ عَشِیًّا
ayahs.translation: They shall not hear in it anything vain; they shall hear only what is good; and they shall have their provision in it, morning and evening.

ayahs.arabicText: تِلْكَ الْجَنَّةُ الَّتِیْ نُوْرِثُ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا مَنْ كَانَ تَقِیًّا
ayahs.translation: Such is the Paradise which We shall cause those of Our servants who have been God-fearing to inherit.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ مَا نَتَنَزَّلُ اِلَّا بِاَمْرِ رَبِّكَ١ۚ لَهٗ مَا بَیْنَ اَیْدِیْنَا وَ مَا خَلْفَنَا وَ مَا بَیْنَ ذٰلِكَ١ۚ وَ مَا كَانَ رَبُّكَ نَسِیًّاۚ
ayahs.translation: (The angels will say): "(O Muhammad!) We descend not except by the command of your Lord. To Him belongs all that is before us and all that is behind us, and all that is in between. Your Lord is not forgetful in the least.

ayahs.arabicText: رَبُّ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضِ وَ مَا بَیْنَهُمَا فَاعْبُدْهُ وَ اصْطَبِرْ لِعِبَادَتِهٖ١ؕ هَلْ تَعْلَمُ لَهٗ سَمِیًّا۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: He is the Lord of the heavens and the earth and all that is in between. Serve Him, then, and be constant in serving Him. Do you know anyone that might be His compeer?"

ayahs.arabicText: وَ یَقُوْلُ الْاِنْسَانُ ءَاِذَا مَا مِتُّ لَسَوْفَ اُخْرَجُ حَیًّا
ayahs.translation: Man is prone to say: "Shall I be raised to life after I die?"

ayahs.arabicText: اَوَ لَا یَذْكُرُ الْاِنْسَانُ اَنَّا خَلَقْنٰهُ مِنْ قَبْلُ وَ لَمْ یَكُ شَیْئًا
ayahs.translation: Does man not remember that We created him before when he was nothing?

ayahs.arabicText: فَوَرَبِّكَ لَنَحْشُرَنَّهُمْ وَ الشَّیٰطِیْنَ ثُمَّ لَنُحْضِرَنَّهُمْ حَوْلَ جَهَنَّمَ جِثِیًّاۚ
ayahs.translation: By your Lord, We will surely muster them and the devils together. Then We will surely bring them all, on their knees, around Hell,

ayahs.arabicText: ثُمَّ لَنَنْزِعَنَّ مِنْ كُلِّ شِیْعَةٍ اَیُّهُمْ اَشَدُّ عَلَى الرَّحْمٰنِ عِتِیًّاۚ
ayahs.translation: and then We will draw aside from each party those who were most rebellious against the Most Compassionate Lord,

ayahs.arabicText: ثُمَّ لَنَحْنُ اَعْلَمُ بِالَّذِیْنَ هُمْ اَوْلٰى بِهَا صِلِیًّا
ayahs.translation: and then We shall know well all those most worthy to be cast in Hell.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اِنْ مِّنْكُمْ اِلَّا وَارِدُهَا١ۚ كَانَ عَلٰى رَبِّكَ حَتْمًا مَّقْضِیًّاۚ
ayahs.translation: There is not one of you but shall pass by Hell. This is a decree which your Lord will fulfil.

ayahs.arabicText: ثُمَّ نُنَجِّی الَّذِیْنَ اتَّقَوْا وَّ نَذَرُ الظّٰلِمِیْنَ فِیْهَا جِثِیًّا
ayahs.translation: Then We shall deliver those that feared Allah and leave the wrong-doers there on their knees.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اِذَا تُتْلٰى عَلَیْهِمْ اٰیٰتُنَا بَیِّنٰتٍ قَالَ الَّذِیْنَ كَفَرُوْا لِلَّذِیْنَ اٰمَنُوْۤا١ۙ اَیُّ الْفَرِیْقَیْنِ خَیْرٌ مَّقَامًا وَّ اَحْسَنُ نَدِیًّا
ayahs.translation: When Our clear revelations are recited to those who deny the Truth they are wont to say to those who have faith: "Which of the two groups has a better status and whose assemblies are grander?"

ayahs.arabicText: وَ كَمْ اَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُمْ مِّنْ قَرْنٍ هُمْ اَحْسَنُ اَثَاثًا وَّ رِءْیًا
ayahs.translation: How numerous are the peoples We destroyed before them - those that were more resourceful and grander in outward appearance!

ayahs.arabicText: قُلْ مَنْ كَانَ فِی الضَّلٰلَةِ فَلْیَمْدُدْ لَهُ الرَّحْمٰنُ مَدًّا١ۚ۬ حَتّٰۤى اِذَا رَاَوْا مَا یُوْعَدُوْنَ اِمَّا الْعَذَابَ وَ اِمَّا السَّاعَةَ١ؕ فَسَیَعْلَمُوْنَ مَنْ هُوَ شَرٌّ مَّكَانًا وَّ اَضْعَفُ جُنْدًا
ayahs.translation: Say: "The Most Compassionate Lord grants respite to those who stray into error, until they behold what they had been threatened with, either God's chastisement (in the world) or the Hour (of Resurrection)" - then they fully know whose station is worse, and who is weaker in hosts!

ayahs.arabicText: وَ یَزِیْدُ اللّٰهُ الَّذِیْنَ اهْتَدَوْا هُدًى١ؕ وَ الْبٰقِیٰتُ الصّٰلِحٰتُ خَیْرٌ عِنْدَ رَبِّكَ ثَوَابًا وَّ خَیْرٌ مَّرَدًّا
ayahs.translation: (On the contrary), Allah increases in guidance those who follow the Right Way. Lasting acts of righteousness are better in the sight of your Lord as reward and conducive to a better end.

ayahs.arabicText: اَفَرَءَیْتَ الَّذِیْ كَفَرَ بِاٰیٰتِنَا وَ قَالَ لَاُوْتَیَنَّ مَالًا وَّ وَلَدًاؕ
ayahs.translation: Have you seen him who rejected Our signs and said: "Surely I shall continue to be favoured with riches and children."

ayahs.arabicText: اَطَّلَعَ الْغَیْبَ اَمِ اتَّخَذَ عِنْدَ الرَّحْمٰنِ عَهْدًاۙ
ayahs.translation: Has he obtained knowledge of the Unseen, or has he taken a covenant with the Most Compassionate Lord?

ayahs.arabicText: كَلَّا١ؕ سَنَكْتُبُ مَا یَقُوْلُ وَ نَمُدُّ لَهٗ مِنَ الْعَذَابِ مَدًّاۙ
ayahs.translation: By no means! We shall write down all what he says; and We shall greatly prolong his chastisement,

ayahs.arabicText: وَّ نَرِثُهٗ مَا یَقُوْلُ وَ یَاْتِیْنَا فَرْدًا
ayahs.translation: and We shall inherit all the resources and hosts of which he boasts, and he will come to Us all alone.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اتَّخَذُوْا مِنْ دُوْنِ اللّٰهِ اٰلِهَةً لِّیَكُوْنُوْا لَهُمْ عِزًّاۙ
ayahs.translation: They have taken other gods instead of Allah that they may be a source of strength for them.

ayahs.arabicText: كَلَّا١ؕ سَیَكْفُرُوْنَ بِعِبَادَتِهِمْ وَ یَكُوْنُوْنَ عَلَیْهِمْ ضِدًّا۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: By no means! They shall soon deny their worship and shall become their adversaries instead.

ayahs.arabicText: اَلَمْ تَرَ اَنَّاۤ اَرْسَلْنَا الشَّیٰطِیْنَ عَلَى الْكٰفِرِیْنَ تَؤُزُّهُمْ اَزًّاۙ
ayahs.translation: Do you not see that We have sent devils upon the unbelievers who greatly incite them (to oppose the Truth)?

ayahs.arabicText: فَلَا تَعْجَلْ عَلَیْهِمْ١ؕ اِنَّمَا نَعُدُّ لَهُمْ عَدًّاۚ
ayahs.translation: Therefore, do not hasten (in seeking a scourge against them). We are counting their days.

ayahs.arabicText: یَوْمَ نَحْشُرُ الْمُتَّقِیْنَ اِلَى الرَّحْمٰنِ وَفْدًاۙ
ayahs.translation: The Day shall soon come when We shall bring together the God-fearing to the Most Compassionate Lord, as honoured guests;

ayahs.arabicText: وَّ نَسُوْقُ الْمُجْرِمِیْنَ اِلٰى جَهَنَّمَ وِرْدًاۘ
ayahs.translation: and We shall drive the guilty ones to Hell as a thirsty herd.

ayahs.arabicText: لَا یَمْلِكُوْنَ الشَّفَاعَةَ اِلَّا مَنِ اتَّخَذَ عِنْدَ الرَّحْمٰنِ عَهْدًاۘ
ayahs.translation: On that Day none will have the power to intercede for them except those who received a sanction from the Most Compassionate Lord.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ قَالُوا اتَّخَذَ الرَّحْمٰنُ وَلَدًاؕ
ayahs.translation: They claim: "The Most Compassionate Lord has taken a son to Himself."

ayahs.arabicText: لَقَدْ جِئْتُمْ شَیْئًا اِدًّاۙ
ayahs.translation: Surely you have made a monstrous statement.

ayahs.arabicText: تَكَادُ السَّمٰوٰتُ یَتَفَطَّرْنَ مِنْهُ وَ تَنْشَقُّ الْاَرْضُ وَ تَخِرُّ الْجِبَالُ هَدًّاۙ
ayahs.translation: It is such a monstrosity that heavens might well-nigh burst forth at it, the earth might be cleaved, and the mountains fall

ayahs.arabicText: اَنْ دَعَوْا لِلرَّحْمٰنِ وَلَدًاۚ
ayahs.translation: at their ascribing a son to the Most Compassionate Lord.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ مَا یَنْۢبَغِیْ لِلرَّحْمٰنِ اَنْ یَّتَّخِذَ وَلَدًاؕ
ayahs.translation: It does not befit the Most Compassionate Lord that He should take a son.

ayahs.arabicText: اِنْ كُلُّ مَنْ فِی السَّمٰوٰتِ وَ الْاَرْضِ اِلَّاۤ اٰتِی الرَّحْمٰنِ عَبْدًاؕ
ayahs.translation: There is no one in the heavens and the earth but he shall come to the Most Compassionate Lord as His servant.

ayahs.arabicText: لَقَدْ اَحْصٰىهُمْ وَ عَدَّهُمْ عَدًّاؕ
ayahs.translation: Verily He encompasses them and has counted them all.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ كُلُّهُمْ اٰتِیْهِ یَوْمَ الْقِیٰمَةِ فَرْدًا
ayahs.translation: On the Day of Resurrection each one of these will come to Him singly.

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّ الَّذِیْنَ اٰمَنُوْا وَ عَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ سَیَجْعَلُ لَهُمُ الرَّحْمٰنُ وُدًّا
ayahs.translation: Indeed, the Most Compassionate Lord will soon create enduring love for those who believe and do righteous works.

ayahs.arabicText: فَاِنَّمَا یَسَّرْنٰهُ بِلِسَانِكَ لِتُبَشِّرَ بِهِ الْمُتَّقِیْنَ وَ تُنْذِرَ بِهٖ قَوْمًا لُّدًّا
ayahs.translation: Therefore, We have revealed the Qur'an in your tongue and made it easy to understand that you may give glad tidings to the God-fearing and warn a contentious people.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ كَمْ اَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُمْ مِّنْ قَرْنٍ١ؕ هَلْ تُحِسُّ مِنْهُمْ مِّنْ اَحَدٍ اَوْ تَسْمَعُ لَهُمْ رِكْزًا۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: How numerous are the peoples that We destroyed before them! Do you now perceive any one of them, or hear even their whisper?
